title: .jgates/tools.yml
description: Tool instances and their bindings to components.

persona.description: zizmor: how strict the audit is (regular: few false positives; pedantic: code smells too; auditor: false positives accepted).

minSeverity.description: zizmor: the lowest severity that is reported.

offline.description: zizmor: true (the default) never calls the GitHub API; false also runs the audits that need it (a GH_TOKEN is required).

engine.description: mutation: the mutation engine (stryker for JavaScript/TypeScript, mutmut for Python, stryker-net for .NET). Without it the engine is detected from the component.

mutate.description: mutation: the scope of the run. Stryker: relative globs of the files to mutate. mutmut: mutant-name patterns. Without it the engine's own configuration decides.

minimumScore.description: mutation: the lowest mutation score (percent of detected mutants) that passes; below it the stage has a blocking finding. The policy rule mutation.minimum applies when this is not set.

e2eRunner.description: playwright: the e2e runner (playwright-test for Playwright Test, pytest for pytest-playwright). Without it the runner is detected from the component.

framework.description: migration-drift: the framework whose drift is checked (django, alembic, prisma, efcore), or squawk, the SQL migration linter. Without it the framework is detected from the component.

databaseUrl.description: migration-drift: the URL of the database of the project's compose services the framework connects to (for example postgresql://app:app@db:5432/app), handed over in DATABASE_URL or the variable databaseUrlEnv names. A test database of the run's own services, never a real one.

databaseUrlEnv.description: migration-drift: the environment variable that carries databaseUrl (default DATABASE_URL).

prismaSchema.description: migration-drift (prisma): the schema file, relative to the component (default prisma/schema.prisma, else schema.prisma).

prismaMigrations.description: migration-drift (prisma): the migrations folder, relative to the component (default: migrations next to the schema).

dotnetProject.description: migration-drift (efcore), performance (benchmarkdotnet): the .csproj relative to the component (default: the one with EF Core migrations, or the one referencing BenchmarkDotNet).

dbContext.description: migration-drift (efcore): the DbContext to check when the project has several.

sql.description: migration-drift (squawk): the SQL migration files to lint, relative paths or patterns of the component (default migrations/**/*.sql).

harness.description: performance: the benchmark harness (pytest-benchmark, vitest-bench, go-bench, criterion, benchmarkdotnet). Without it the harness is detected from the component.

budgets.description: performance: benchmark name (or a pattern with *) -> the maximum mean time per iteration in milliseconds. A benchmark over its budget, and a budget no benchmark that ran matches, are blocking findings.

baseline.description: performance: a JSON file relative to the component with the mean times of a trusted run (benchmark name -> milliseconds; every run writes baseline-candidate.json in its outputs). A benchmark slower than its baseline by more than maxRegressionPercent is a blocking finding.

maxRegressionPercent.description: performance: how much slower than the baseline a benchmark may be, in percent (default 20).

spec.description: oasdiff, schemathesis, zap: the OpenAPI specification, relative to the scan root (oasdiff and schemathesis default: openapi.yaml, openapi.json, swagger.* or the same under api/, docs/, spec/; zap: when set, the API scan replaces the baseline).

target.description: schemathesis, zap, playwright: the base URL (http:// or https://, no credentials, query or fragment) of the running local or disposable environment to test, or service:<name>:<port>[/path] for a service of the project's compose (jgates.yml services), which the run starts and the check reaches on the run's network. schemathesis and zap: without it the stage is blocked, never passed; playwright: without it the services target of jgates.yml is used.

auth.description: schemathesis, zap: the authentication header sent to the target. The value is read at run time from the environment variable valueEnv; the secret itself is never written here.

seed.description: schemathesis: the random seed of the generated test cases (default 1), so a run can be reproduced.

maxExamples.description: schemathesis: the maximum number of test cases per API operation (default 50).

requestTimeoutSeconds.description: schemathesis: the timeout of each request sent to the target (default 10 s); timeoutSeconds bounds the whole stage.

checks.description: schemathesis: the checks applied to every response (default: not_a_server_error, status_code_conformance, content_type_conformance, response_schema_conformance).

mode.description: zap: passive (default: baseline or API scan with passive rules only) or active (attack payloads; refused unless allowActive is true).

allowActive.description: zap: the explicit permission for mode: active. The plan then lists the effects of the active scan on the target.

image.description: generic-command: where the command runs: `tools` (default, the JGates tools image), `extension` (the image built from .jgates/image/Dockerfile) or the reference of a ready image, pinned by digest on first use. zap: no longer used. ZAP runs in the JGates tools image and no other image can be named; setting it blocks the plan with the reason.

blockingRisk.description: zap: the lowest alert risk that blocks (default medium).

spiderMinutes.description: zap: how long the spider of the baseline or full scan may crawl (default 1 minute).

baseRef.description: oasdiff: the git revision (branch, tag, commit) whose copy of the specification is the reference. Without baseRef or baseSpec the stage is blocked.

baseSpec.description: oasdiff: a reference specification file, instead of a git revision.

failOn.description: oasdiff: the lowest level of change that blocks (ERR: breaking; WARN: also potentially breaking).

blockOn.description: supply-chain: the lowest severity of a lockfile finding that blocks (default high; none: findings are reported and never block).

allowInstallScripts.description: supply-chain: true (the default) reports install scripts without blocking; false makes them findings of high severity that follow blockOn.

trustedHosts.description: supply-chain: registry hosts accepted as public (default: registry.npmjs.org, registry.yarnpkg.com, pypi.org, files.pythonhosted.org).

lockfiles.description: supply-chain: the lockfiles to read, relative to the workspace (default: the npm and Python lockfiles found in the workspace; list requirements.txt here to read it).

imageRef.description: trivy: the reference of a final container image to scan (trivy image) instead of the filesystem. It must already be present in the local daemon or reachable by Trivy; JGates never builds or pulls it. Set only one of imageRef and imageTarball.

imageTarball.description: trivy: a saved image tarball (docker save) to scan with trivy image --input, relative to the workspace or absolute, instead of the filesystem. Set only one of imageRef and imageTarball.

language.description: codeql: the language of the database the instance creates (required; python, javascript-typescript, java-kotlin, go, csharp, ruby, swift, rust, c-cpp, actions).

suite.description: codeql: the query suite to run (default: security-extended).

buildCommand.description: codeql: the command that builds the project for a compiled language (default: CodeQL's autobuild).

checker.description: build-check: which compiler or type checker the instance runs (tsc, mypy, pyright, go, cargo, dotnet). It checks every unit of its stack that carries the project's configuration for it.

formatter.description: format-check: which formatter the instance runs in check mode (ruff: ruff format --check; prettier: prettier --check; gofmt: gofmt -l; rustfmt: cargo fmt --check; dotnet: dotnet format whitespace --verify-no-changes). It checks the whole component with the project's own style configuration.

maxLines.description: file-size: the most lines a text file may have before it is a finding (default 5000).

tsconfig.description: build-check (tsc): the tsconfig file to pass to tsc -p, relative to the component (default: tsconfig.json).

rulePack.description: A rule pack shipped with JGates that the instance runs next to its own rules (semgrep: jgates).

selection.description: Test runners (pytest, vitest, jest, go-test, cargo-test, dotnet-test): what counts as an integration test. An instance with only the integration capability runs this selection alone, and the unit run leaves it out, so no test counts twice; a unit instance without its own selection uses the one of the integration instance of the same adapter and component. Each stack reads its own keys; without them its default applies (pytest: tests/integration, else the integration marker; vitest/jest: a project named integration, else *.integration.test.* files; go: the integration build tag; cargo: the tests/ targets; .NET: Category=Integration).

marker.description: pytest: the marker of the integration tests (-m).

paths.description: pytest: folders (or files) of the integration tests, relative to the component.

project.description: vitest/jest: the project (workspace entry) that holds the integration tests.

pattern.description: vitest/jest: a glob of the integration test files, relative to the component (**, *, ?, {a,b}).

tag.description: go: the build tag of the integration test files.

targets.description: cargo: the integration test targets (names of tests/<name>.rs).

category.description: .NET: the value of the Category trait of the integration tests.

commandDeclaration.description: generic-command: the declaration of the command (effects and evidence contract); the adapter checks it against generic-evidence.schema.json when the plan is built. This is what `jgates tools add-custom` writes.
